profiles.title: Tuning Profiles
profiles.subtitle: Switch entire system configurations in 1 click across mouse precision, DirectX latency, and services with 100% rollback guarantee.

esports.name: Esports Competitive
esports.desc: Engineered for maximum FPS pacing, lowest sensor jitter, and minimum input lag. Disables mouse acceleration, sets 1:1 raw input, enables DirectX Flip presentation, activates Game Mode, and strips background telemetry.

streaming.name: Streaming & Content Creation
streaming.desc: Balanced configuration for multi-application streaming (OBS, Discord, Premiere, games). Disables GameDVR capture conflicts, prevents background network telemetry spikes, while maintaining GPU pipeline headroom for hardware video encoding.

battery.name: Maximum Battery / Quiet
battery.desc: Power efficiency profile for laptops and quiet workstation usage. Halts background diagnostics, disables unnecessary services, restores default system timer resolution to conserve CPU package C-states, and minimizes background wakeups.

default.name: Windows Default / Revert All
default.desc: Rolls back all optimizations to official Windows 11 factory defaults. Restores telemetry services (DiagTrack, WerSvc), standard mouse acceleration curves, default Game DVR recording, and default DirectX presentation queues.

modal.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the purpose and target games of this profile...
modal.selectTweaksPrompt: Select which system, gaming, and privacy tweaks to include in this profile:
modal.disableAccelerationDesc: Removes Windows pointer ballistics for linear muscle memory.
modal.rawInputModeDesc: Bypasses Windows message pump acceleration curves.
modal.directXFlipDesc: Upgrades windowed games to modern DXGI borderless flip model.
modal.directXLatencyDesc: Reduces queued prerendered GPU frames to 1 for lowest motion-to-photon latency.
modal.shaderCacheDesc: Prevents in-game compilation micro-stutters in DirectX 12 titles.

disableCortana.name: Disable Cortana
disableCortana.desc: Prevents Cortana voice assistant from running and consuming background memory.

disableWebSearch.name: Disable Web Search in Start Menu
disableWebSearch.desc: Stops Windows Search from sending local keystrokes to Bing and displaying web suggestions.

enableGameMode.name: Enable Windows Game Mode
enableGameMode.desc: Prioritizes CPU and GPU resources for active games, reducing background task interruptions.

disableGameDVR.name: Disable Game DVR Background Recording
disableGameDVR.desc: Eliminates frame stuttering and micro-freezes by turning off continuous background capture.

disableTelemetry.name: Disable Windows Telemetry & Diagnostics
disableTelemetry.desc: Stops DiagTrack service and sets telemetry policy to 0, restricting background system diagnostics.

disableWer.name: Disable Windows Error Reporting (WerSvc)
disableWer.desc: Disables background WerSvc service and crash dump transmissions to Microsoft telemetry servers.

disableCortanaCopilot.name: Disable Cortana & Windows Copilot Telemetry
disableCortanaCopilot.desc: Prevents Bing web search indexing, Cortana voice telemetry, and Windows Copilot data collection.

disableAdvertisingId.name: Disable Advertising ID Tracking
disableAdvertisingId.desc: Prevents Microsoft and third-party apps from tracking user activity for personalized ad profiling.

disableActivityHistory.name: Disable Activity History & Timeline Upload
disableActivityHistory.desc: Stops Windows from publishing user application usage histories and uploading activity feeds to the cloud.

disableLocationDiagnostics.name: Disable Location Tracking & App Diagnostics
disableLocationDiagnostics.desc: Blocks background geolocation sensor polling and stops Windows from harvesting diagnostic data from apps.

disableAcceleration.name: Disable Pointer Precision (Mouse Acceleration)
disableAcceleration.desc: Eliminates variable cursor velocity scaling for consistent 1:1 muscle memory aim.

neutralPointerSpeed.name: Set Neutral Pointer Speed (6/11)
neutralPointerSpeed.desc: Sets Windows pointer sensitivity to the neutral 1:1 ratio, preventing sub-pixel skips or software interpolation.

disableCursorShadow.name: Disable Pointer Trails & Cursor Shadow
disableCursorShadow.desc: Removes visual rendering overhead and trails on the mouse pointer.

usbSelectiveSuspend.name: Disable USB Selective Suspend
usbSelectiveSuspend.desc: Keeps USB mouse ports continuously active to prevent sleep delay when holding crosshair angles.

keyboardRepeatRate.name: Maximize Keyboard Repeat Rate & Zero Delay
keyboardRepeatRate.desc: Minimizes initial key repeat delay to 0 and maximizes speed for instant continuous actions and strafing.

disableFilterKeys.name: Disable Filter Keys (No Shift Delay)
disableFilterKeys.desc: Eliminates the built-in Windows delay when holding down or rapidly tapping the Shift key.

disableStickyToggleKeys.name: Disable Sticky Keys & Toggle Keys
disableStickyToggleKeys.desc: Completely prevents the 5x Shift popup and modifier key locking during fast gameplay.

disableAltShiftToggle.name: Disable In-Game Language Switch (Alt+Shift)
disableAltShiftToggle.desc: Prevents accidental language switching when pressing Alt and Shift together during walking or jumping.

numlockOnBoot.name: Enable Num Lock on Startup
numlockOnBoot.desc: Automatically turns on Num Lock upon Windows boot for convenience.

disableWinKey.name: Disable Windows Key (Gaming WinLock)
disableWinKey.desc: Prevents accidental Start Menu popups during gameplay by disabling the Windows key (requires reboot).

mmcssPriority.name: Optimize Input Thread Priority (MMCSS)
mmcssPriority.desc: Prioritizes low-latency input scheduling against background DPC and disk interrupt storms.

vbsDisable.name: Disable VBS & Memory Integrity (HVCI)
vbsDisable.desc: Delivers several to 10% better frame pacing and CPU-bound FPS by removing virtualization overhead.
vbsDisable.warning: Reduces core kernel memory defense against rogue drivers. Recommended strictly for dedicated gaming rigs.

timerResolution.name: Global 0.5ms Timer Resolution
timerResolution.desc: Smoother cursor motion and tighter frame pacing across Windows 11.
timerResolution.warning: Slightly increases power draw and CPU heat. Not recommended while running on laptop battery.

spectreMeltdown.name: Disable Spectre & Meltdown Mitigations
spectreMeltdown.desc: Recovers CPU performance on older Intel processors by disabling branch predictor mitigation penalties.
spectreMeltdown.warning: Leaves CPU speculative execution mitigations inactive. Use with informed consent.
